roadmap_scope: Current and goal Q rows, one continuous token each; all conditions have the same text graph and explicit current/goal IDs.

prompts.system: You are solving a task on a fixed, undirected, unweighted graph.

scoring.decision: Extract the explicit decision before graph scoring; unresolved outputs require separate semantic review.
scoring.successful_action: Any adjacent node with strictly smaller shortest-path distance to the goal.
scoring.accuracy_denominator: All 100 ordered test pairs per condition for each node count.

comparison: Same graph, same fixed test split, prompt and generation budget; action-trained MLP against equal-budget report-only continuation. Existing text and report-MLP predictions from the scaling run are not regenerated.
interpretation: Exploratory within-graph action-supervision transfer. Only two previously unevaluated checkpoints are generated; old scaling text/report baselines remain separate existing evidence. Compare action continuation chiefly against matched report continuation, not across graph sizes.
